en: Color-tinted vintage postcard view of a calm waterfront scene bordered by lush green trees. A small passenger boat is moored along a quay on the left, with a path running beside the water. Farther out on the water a sailboat is visible against a pale yellow sky. The caption in red text at the top reads "Stockholm. Parti från Djurgården." indicating the scene is from Djurgården in Stockholm.
